name: 更好的故障机器人 / Better Defect
author: Codex
description: v103/vPC/v110 compatible full build: restores 26 old Defect cards and adds the Ancient card 偏差认知*改 for Darv's Dusty Tome. Transformed Recycle costs 1 energy at both upgrade levels; its normal upgrade now removes Exhaust instead of reducing the cost to 0. Includes the Fission orb visual fix, starter Strike -> Ball Lightning option, 10 historical versions and 59 custom transformations with a persistent 50-point budget. Dynamic reward odds and card disabling live in the standalone DynamicCardOdds mod. No BaseLib.
